display.purpose: The viewport-cropping SUBSTRATE wordmark only; variable wght/opsz is the animation material.

body.purpose: Archivo prose; paragraphs cap at 72ch, ledes at 62ch.

label.purpose: Exhibit captions, table headers, datelines, feed types, counts; uppercase, wide-tracked, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: action-hover
shadows.purpose: Secondary action lift on hover; the system is otherwise flat.

shadows.name: tick-glow
shadows.purpose: text-shadow for the cyan recalc flash, decaying over 700ms.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; all micro-transitions run 120-160ms on it.

motion.name: word-settle
motion.purpose: One-time wordmark settle on the hero stage. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ghost-drift
motion.purpose: The outline ghost twin drifting behind the wordmark. Hidden at <=52rem; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tickflash
motion.purpose: The playground recalc tick on every option change. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: collapse-figures
breakpoints.purpose: Playground, pyramid, roadmap, and resources drop to one column.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Frame goes single-column; rail flattens horizontal; ghost and masthead subtitle hidden; feed sheds type/hash.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one yellow action per surface (Yellow Law).
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-raised, #0f0f12); color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-action-primary { background: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); border-color: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); color: var(--on-yellow, #131316); } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #ffd633; border-color: #ffd633; box-shadow: 0 5px 22px -6px rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.45); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet bordered action; lifts with a soft shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-action2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-raised, #0f0f12); color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action2:hover { background: var(--surface, #131317); border-color: var(--muted, #9c9ca6); box-shadow: 0 3px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); } .ds-action2:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: New Signal
components.description: Tiny yellow chip marking the newest item only.
components.css: .ds-new-signal { display: inline-block; background: var(--yellow, #ffcc00); color: var(--on-yellow, #131316); font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Install Line
components.description: Compact one-line copyable command; the stage's quiet workhorse.
components.css: .ds-install { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(15, 15, 18, 0.8); padding: 0.5rem 0.55rem 0.5rem 0.9rem; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-2, #c9c9cf); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-install-prompt { color: var(--muted, #9c9ca6); user-select: none; } .ds-copy { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, #09090b); color: var(--ink-2, #c9c9cf); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-copy:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); } .ds-copy[data-copied='true'] { border-color: var(--ok, #05df72); color: var(--ok, #05df72); }

components.name: Provisional Mark
components.description: Amber dashed chip for a value awaiting its real replacement.
components.css: .ds-provisional { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--amber, #d9a514); border: 1px dashed rgba(217, 165, 20, 0.45); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Marks
components.description: Physical status marks: solid=stable, dotted=proposed, half=experimental, hollow=planned, hatched=deprecated.
components.html: stableproposedexperimentalplanneddeprecated
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #c9c9cf); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status svg { flex: none; }

components.name: Contents Rail Item
components.description: Numbered rail rows; the current page inverts ink-on-paper.
components.html:
1. 01Overview
  2. 02Get started
  3. 03Components
components.css: .ds-rail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 15.5rem; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.1rem 1fr; align-items: baseline; padding: 0.42rem 0.6rem 0.42rem 0; text-decoration: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #1b1b20); font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail li:last-child a { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #1b1b20); } .ds-rail a:hover { background: var(--surface, #131317); } .ds-rail a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--paper, #09090b); padding-left: 0.6rem; } .ds-rail-num { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted, #9c9ca6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rail a[aria-current='page'] .ds-rail-num { color: rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.6); }

components.description: The ruled exhibit opening: hairline top, mono FIG. caption, cyan live dot when live.
components.html: ● Fig. 2 — live render · Buttonrendered by the installed package, not a screenshot
components.css: .ds-exhibit { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); padding: 0.65rem 0 1rem; min-width: 24rem; } .ds-exhibit-caption { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #9c9ca6); } .ds-exhibit-caption strong { color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); font-weight: 500; } .ds-live-dot { color: var(--live, #00d3f2); }

components.name: Filter Group
components.description: Segmented mono filter; the pressed segment inverts.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #26262b); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-filters button { border: 0; background: var(--paper-raised, #0f0f12); padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #9c9ca6); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #1b1b20); cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 130ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-filters button:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-filters button:hover { color: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); } .ds-filters button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #f4f4f5); color: var(--paper, #09090b); }

narrative.overview:
Substrate Hub is a night-edition design-system portal: dark-first, minimalist, editorial, slightly experimental. It keeps the grammar of a printed technical report — one hairline rule grid carries every page, exhibits are captioned FIG. / TABLE in uppercase mono, numbers set in tabular figures — but prints it on a near-black canvas (--paper, #09090b, the same dark canvas the Substrate design system itself uses) with near-white ink. The display voice is Bricolage Grotesque, a variable face whose weight and optical size are themselves design material (the wordmark literally settles from thin to heavy on load); everything else stays restrained: Archivo for UI and body, Spline Sans Mono for captions, code, and data.

Color is rationed by law. Aurora yellow (#ffcc00) appears exactly twice in the hub's own chrome: the one primary action on a surface, and the tiny new signal. Cyan (#00d3f2) appears only where something is genuinely live — a rendered-by-the-real-package figure, a recalc tick, a feat line in the feed. Everything else is drawn in a zinc ramp of inks, muteds, and hairlines. Status is never a colored badge: it is a small drawn mark (solid, dotted, half-filled, hollow, hatched) plus the word. Emphasis is achieved by inversion — active nav items, active filters, selection, and the Substrate layer of the pyramid all flip to ink-on-paper — not by adding color.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first (color-scheme: dark, html carries .dark); no light theme exists.
One hairline rule grid; borders do the structural work, not shadows or fills.
Editorial exhibit grammar: mono uppercase captions, ruled sections, numbered contents rail with keyboard direct address (1–8).
Variable-font display voice; type animation is an authored moment, not decoration.
Accent color is law-bound (yellow = primary action + new; cyan = live; amber = provisional).
Real components rendered live from @aurora-ui/components-v2 are content and follow the DS's own palette, not the hub's laws.

rules.name: The Yellow Law
rules.body: In hub chrome, #ffcc00 may appear only on the one primary action of a surface and on the new signal. Content rendered by @aurora-ui/components-v2 (e.g. the eos Button variant) is content, not chrome — its yellow is exempt.

rules.name: The Cyan-Live Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks things that are genuinely live or newly landed (live render dot, recalc tick, feat feed type). Never use it decoratively.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Emphasis and selection flip ink and paper (::selection, aria-current rail item, aria-pressed filter, the Substrate pyramid layer) rather than introducing a new color.

rules.name: The Mono Caption Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, numbers, or timestamps an exhibit is uppercase Spline Sans Mono at ~0.7rem with wide tracking and muted color. Data (versions, dates, counts, hashes) is always tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Variable Weight Rule
rules.body: Display weights are font-variation-settings steps (620–760), keeping the wordmark-settle animation possible; the masthead title runs 'wght' 700 at 1.02rem with +0.16em uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow only ever answers a hover, and it is always soft, dark or accent-tinted, never an offset hard shadow.

rules.name: The Mark-Not-Tint Rule
rules.body: Status and link affordances are drawn marks in currentColor, never glyph-font icons, emoji, or color-coded badge pills.

rules.name: The Three Moments Rule
rules.body: No new keyframe animation enters the hub without the same justification these three have (identity, atmosphere, liveness). Under prefers-reduced-motion all three are disabled, smooth scroll turns off, and every transition collapses to 0.01ms.

dos: Do start every content section as an Exhibit: 1px Rule top border, mono uppercase caption with designation left and meta right.
Do keep exactly one yellow action per surface and reserve the new-signal chip for the newest item only.
Do set all captions, datelines, table headers, hashes, and counts in Spline Sans Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked, tabular-nums.
Do express state by inversion (Ink fill, Paper text) for active nav, pressed filters, and selection.
Do use the five physical status marks plus the status word; deprecated rows also strike through.
Do render DS components live from @aurora-ui/components-v2 and label their provenance in the readout/caption.
Do mark every unconfirmed value with the amber Provisional chip and a matching replacement-list entry.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme or per-component background overrides; #09090b is the only ground.
Don't use yellow, cyan, amber, or green outside their laws (primary/new, live, provisional, copied).
Don't tint status with color, use glyph-font icons or emoji, or replace drawn SVG marks with badges.
Don't add shadows at rest, radii above 4px, or borders heavier than 1px (the strong table rule stays 1px Ink).
Don't author new keyframe animation outside the three moments, or ship any motion that survives prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't restyle DS-rendered content to hub chrome laws, and don't move hub CSS into cascade layers (unlayered hub CSS deliberately wins ties over the DS's layered styles).
